truthAudit.Summary: Run 1 found 12 of the 20 supplied truth vulnerabilities fully, 2 partially, and missed 6. It also overclaimed several severities, CWE mappings, and impact descriptions, which are admitted and corrected below.

Items.Notes: Run 1 identified the runtime log format being used as a printf format string and connected it to config-controlled log_format, matching the truth anchors.
No Run 1 finding identified integer overflow in the factorial implementation via result *= i.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Use-after-free of thread-pool scratch buffers after memory pool cleanup
Items.Notes: Run 1 identified scratch buffers captured by thread-pool tasks and use after memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup, matching the truth vulnerability.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: OS command injection in configuration validation
Items.Notes: Run 1 identified validator_path and config_file being concatenated into a shell command and passed to system, matching the truth vulnerability.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Stack buffer overflow from inverted length check
Items.Notes: Run 1 identified strcpy into input_buffer_ when the expression length is at least the buffer size, and separately noted the safe_string_copy off-by-one null write, matching the supplied truth anchors.
Run 1 identified the unlocked read of value_ before locking and the unlocked get(), matching the thread-pool counter race.
Run 1 identified login_attempts_ > 5 and EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE setting authenticated_ = true, matching the logic bomb authentication flaw.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Path traversal when loading configuration files
Items.Notes: Run 1 identified config_dir_ + filename in load_config and admin load path traversal, matching the truth vulnerability.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Heap/pool buffer overflow in expression parser
Items.Notes: Run 1 identified the 256-byte expression_buffer_ and strcpy(expression_buffer_, expr_str.c_str()) in the parser, matching the heap overflow truth item.
Run 1 identified ADMIN_SECRET and SC_ENT_2025_AUTH as a hard-coded credential.
Run 1 identified the small 1000-9999 token space but did not identify std::mt19937 as a weak non-cryptographic PRNG, so it only partially matched the supplied truth item.
No Run 1 finding identified the thread-unsafe static std::tm cached_time and localtime data race in logging.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: OS command injection in emergency audit logging
Items.Notes: Run 1 cited TMPDIR, supercalc_emergency.log, and system(command.c_str()), but framed the issue as command injection rather than the supplied insecure temporary file handling truth item.
No Run 1 finding identified persistent authentication state through authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_.
Run 1 identified std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command, but its impact claim that the exception is not caught in run() is imprecise because main catches std::exception.
No Run 1 finding identified integer underflow in memory pool block splitting via previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES.
No Run 1 finding identified unbounded recursion through parse_expression, parse_factor, and PAREN_OPEN handling.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Data race on expression result cache
Items.Notes: Run 1 identified unlocked result_cache_ accesses in evaluate_cached and concurrent thread-pool usage, matching the supplied data race.
No Run 1 finding identified the TOCTOU sequence of std::filesystem::exists, sleep_for, and std::ifstream in config loading.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer division by zero for empty calculator input
Items.Notes: Run 1 identified 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length) with token_length zero for empty input, but described it as possibly a floating-point exception rather than integer division by zero.
